directive.name: planning
directive.description: Create implementation plans that build in compliance from the start

context.principle: Plans should be designed so code review passes on first attempt
Zero backwards compatibility - break things properly, update all callers
Tests and documentation are part of the plan, not afterthoughts

process.rule: Apply all design constraints before designing the solution
List all modules with correct suffixes and verify dependency DAG
Include TSDoc signatures for all new public APIs
Include test strategy with what to test and how to mock
Define implementation order: computers, capabilities, orchestrator (extension.ts)

check.item: No policy logic planned for capabilities
VSCode API calls only in capabilities
Computers are pure functions with no VSCode imports
All public APIs have planned TSDoc
Tests planned for all new functionality

example.code:
## Module Structure
### Computers (pure functions) - `task-parser.computer.ts` - XML parsing logic - Dependencies: fast-xml-parser (external)
- `task-actions.computer.ts` - Compute available actions per status - Dependencies: none
### Capabilities (VSCode API) - `file-system.capability.ts` - File read/write operations - Dependencies: none (uses fs module)
- `terminal.capability.ts` - Terminal creation and commands - Dependencies: none (uses vscode API)
- `tasks-view.capability.ts` - TreeView provider - Dependencies: task-parser.computer, task-actions.computer (via injection)
### Orchestrator - `extension.ts` - Wires everything in activate() - Creates computers and capabilities - Registers commands and providers
## Implementation Order 1. task-parser.computer.ts (no dependencies) 2. task-actions.computer.ts (no dependencies) 3. file-system.capability.ts (uses fs) 4. terminal.capability.ts (uses vscode) 5. tasks-view.capability.ts (injects computers) 6. extension.ts (orchestrates all) 7. Tests for computers (pure functions are easy to test)
example.explanation: Plan with proper categorization, order, and constraints built in

example.code: ## Breaking Changes - Rename oldFunction to newFunction - Add backwards compatibility re-export for oldFunction
## Breaking Changes - Rename oldFunction to newFunction - Update all 5 callers in: fileA.ts, fileB.ts, fileC.ts, fileD.ts, fileE.ts
example.explanation: Plan direct updates, no compatibility layer
